fact_text: The reporter said Pakistan has moved from a gas shortage to an oversupply, with weaker demand and planned LNG cargoes arriving at the same time.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Under the 2023 IMF agreement the government removed gas price subsidies and raised gas prices several-fold, which reduced demand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: The government imposed an additional levy on industries generating power from gas and RLNG, to cut their capacity charges and push them to use grid electricity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Pakistan joined a group of countries where 25% or more of electricity is generated by solar, which reduced gas requirements for power.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: LNG contracts signed 8 to 9 years earlier were based on electricity demand growth projections that did not materialise, as industrial power demand grew slower than forecast.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Under merit order, plants dispatch the cheapest source first; local gas and coal power costs PKR 13 to 15 per unit, while RLNG-based generation costs PKR 21 per unit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Pakistan holds three long-term LNG deals with Qatar and Italy's ENI, under which ten cargoes were due each month.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Pakistan agreed with Qatar and ENI to defer about 60 LNG cargoes over 2026-2027.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Under the deferral, Qatar resells the deferred cargoes internationally; any profit above the contract price goes to Qatar, while any sale below it is a loss borne by Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Saad Hanif, head of research at Ismail Iqbal Securities, estimated Pakistan could save $8 to $10 million on each deferred LNG cargo, because the contracted and spot LNG prices differ.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Over two years the LNG deferral could save Pakistan about $600 million, according to Saad Hanif of Ismail Iqbal Securities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: The RLNG price is set on a three-month average of Brent, so the government bears the loss when RLNG sells below its contract price.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: Gas from local exploration and production companies is much cheaper than RLNG, so bringing it into the system benefits Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: New gas discoveries not yet online will add supply, and production is expected to return to earlier levels once the connection and allocation process is streamlined, the reporter said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)

fact_text: The reporter said the LNG deferral aims to bring cheap local gas into the system, resolve exploration company issues and avoid harm to the national exchequer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From Too Little to Too Much: Pakistan's Gas Oversupply Explained | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-09)
